mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `item` (title, description, category, type, status, view_count, comment_count, collection_count, location, lost_time, image_urls, contact_info, publisher_openid, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{type}, #{status}, 0, 0, 0, #{location}, #{lostTime}, #{imageUrls}, #{contactInfo}, #{publisherOpenid}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `item` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `item` SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `item` SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `item` SET collection_count = collection_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `item` SET collection_count = GREATEST(collection_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
